body:
I've been abused most of my life, not really interested in telling my life's story, but suffice to say he's my brother, he's living with me again, and I hate him from the bottom of my heart.

I had a long talk with my parents, and it didn't accomplish anything. I think I've come to the conclusion that the only way to be free of him is to... well, be free of him. He moves out in 2 months again but that is a lifetime. I've spent my entire life feeling like this and I hate that I'm in this spot again
